text.en:
There shall be established in the Municipality of Lapinig, Province of Northern Samar, an
agro-industrial high school, to be known as the Lapinig Agro-Industrial High School.

The Director of Secondary Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary
to carry out the purposes of this Act.

Such sum as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of said school shall be
provided in subsequent General Appropriations Acts, until which time the operation of the institution as a
national high school shall be deferred.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
